description: Rapport du Gouvernement au Parlement sur les colonnes montantes d'électricité is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministère de la Transition écologique. The rising column of electricity is the terminal element of the connection of consumers to the public electricity networks in residential buildings. In 2015, several press articles estimated that 300,000 buildings were equipped with high-risk columns and required works of the order of EUR 6 billion. Coverage: Ministère de la Transition écologique. The portal shows the English title as "Report from the Government to Parliament on rising electricity columns" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ministère de la Transition écologique. Its keywords include consommateurs, immeuble, cgedd, electricite, dgec, colonnes-montantes. The listing shows 2 download or service links in PDF. The listing shows 2018-01-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
